report.title: Multidimensional Autonomy in Artificial Intelligence: Validating a Governance and Accountability Framework
report.summary: The governance of artificial intelligence systems has historically been constrained by a fundamental ontological challenge: the classification of computational systems as either strictly "autonomous" or "non-autonomous." This binary classification model fails to capture the sociotechnical realities…
